text:
Clara (Finance): FYI INV-2026-0999 for Nimbus Dataworks ($64,920) just moved to dunning after two failed attempts (card & ACH). Bank message: 'refer to payer'.
Nimbus Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0999 marked Past Due (due 2026-07-15). Late notice #1 queued to billing@nis-data.com.
Diego (AM): I spoke with Asha earlier. They're mid-quarter and have short-term cash pressure. Asked if we can split into a 3-part plan with first payment today to stop escalation.
Asha (Nimbus Finance): yes - we can pay 35% today if you can hold collection and waive one late fee. We'll provide an internal memo from CFO and set the remainder over two equal ACHs next month. Also flagged line item 9: a license add-on we thought was trialed.
Vik (Collections Lead): policy: need 40% upfront by default, but we can make exception at 35% with a formal acceptance email + CFO memo and AP contact. We'll waive one late fee if docs provided. Need payment reference and set a 21-day follow-up.
Ruth (Legal): no MSA change required for <$75k. Recommend using this exact clause in the confirmation email: "This payment schedule amends only the timing of payment for INV-2026-0999 and does not waive any other contractual rights." Paste and use verbatim.
Kei (Support): heads-up on the license add-on dispute - engineering shows a trial flag was not set due to a deployment race; suggest a one-time credit of $1,200 if customer accepts plan.
Clara (Finance): include the $1,200 credit in the adjusted balance before calculating 35%. New total = 63,720. 35% upfront = $22,302. Please confirm amounts in email.
Diego (AM): drafting quick email: ```Hi Asha/AP - we can accept 35% upfront ($22,302) today and two ACH payments of $20,709 each on 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-19 after applying a $1,200 license credit. Please reply with: (1) CFO memo attached, (2) AP contact email, and (3) ACH reference when payments post. Upon receipt of the first payment and documentation we will suspend dunning and waive one late fee. Reply with "I accept" to confirm.```
Asha (Nimbus Finance): replying: "I accept. CFO memo attached. AP contact ap+payments@nis-data.com. Initiating payment now (will paste bank ref)."
Nimbus Billing Bot: Payment attempt logged: Card attempt failed; ACH initiated for $22,302 (pending settlement 1-3 business days).
Vik (Collections Lead): hold escalation. If ACH doesn't clear by 1801280000 we'll resume dunning and escalate to Legal. Once settled mark PAYMENT_PLAN_ACTIVE and apply WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE.
Ruth (Legal): uploaded exact clause to thread - please use it unchanged in outgoing email.
Kei (Support): attached reconcile and credit calc; noted the $1,200 credit.
Clara (Finance): setting invoice to PENDING_PAYMENT_PLAN and adding follow-up task. Will confirm when bank ref posts.
Asha (Nimbus Finance): bank trace posted: TRACE-NB-0x5a7. will update when settled.
Nimbus Billing Bot: Settlement confirmed for $22,302. Remaining balance scheduled per plan. Thread status: payment plan active.
Vik (Collections Lead): confirmed - suspending dunning. Will mark WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE and schedule follow-up reminder 2026-08-04.
Diego (AM): thanks team 44d closing for now but will reopen if any mismatch on remaining invoices.
Clara (Finance): recording credit and plan in billing system. Closing thread pending successful future payments. :white_check_mark:
